bpr.source: fitted from TNTP Sioux Falls (protocol 15.2, C-BPR; journal J-0010)

description: Single-link removal scan (optional). Implements the frozen EXP-005 protocol v1.0 without choosing any parameter: 4x4 grids, seeds 1000-1099 (EXP-003 instances), rho = 2 with the instance demand unchanged after removal, UE by gradient projection at RG <= 1e-6 and 20,000 sweeps (umbrella 7, 15.3), every single directed link removed (48), removals that disconnect an OD pair skipped and counted, links lowering TSTT_UE by more than 1e-4 relative flagged and re-solved at 1e-8 with the full network. Added after the freeze, before any EXP-005 data.
label: confirmatory
